description: This file implements a ChannelManager for managing channel lifecycle, including starting, stopping, and monitoring channels and their accounts, with support for retries, backoff policies, and configuration resolution.

methods.name: createRuntimeStore
methods.description: Creates and returns a new runtime store object with maps for abort controllers, starting promises, tasks, and runtimes.

methods.name: isAccountEnabled
methods.description: Determines if an account object is enabled based on its 'enabled' property.

methods.name: resolveDefaultRuntime
methods.description: Resolves and returns the default runtime snapshot for a given channel ID.

methods.name: cloneDefaultRuntime
methods.description: Creates a clone of the default runtime snapshot for a specific channel ID and account ID.

methods.name: applyDescribedAccountFields
methods.description: Applies optional descriptive fields to a ChannelAccountSnapshot object.

methods.name: createChannelManager
methods.description: Main function that creates and returns a ChannelManager object with methods to manage channel lifecycle, including start, stop, snapshot, and health monitoring.
